notes.title: Avicii Invector Encore Edition | Nintendo Switch | 8 Bit Bonus Song ◢◤
notes.notes:
⁉️ DID YOU KNOW ⁉️

3 years ago...

We teamed up with chiptune musical maestros [url=https://www.youtube.com/@8BitUniverse/about]The 8 Bit Universe[/url] to recreate a wonderful rendition of  'Wake Me Up'.

[previewyoutube=iv20nFtXbwk;full][/previewyoutube]

Then we locked it away behind a cheat code in the Nintendo Switch version of Avicii Invector.

Tim spent huge amounts of time in early development, talking about his love for gaming, he shared the same wonder for the early days of gaming and enthusiasm that we all did, and it was a driving force that led to his invention of the Avicii Invector project.

Bringing Invector to Nintendo Switch, we wanted to make a fitting tribute both to an iconic artist, and that same passion and love of old-school cool that he shared.
This is completely free – and in-game today, just hit ↑ ↓ ↓ ↓ ↓ ↓ ↓ A on the main menu.

Avicii Invector is currently discounted by 70%

Whilst you hydrate (seriously, it's like 2000 degrees out there) and stay cool and safe indoors with your indie games, we thought we'd point your attention to our Summer event which just started!

notes.title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles
notes.notes:
You won't want to miss this!

Our publisher [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WIRED]Wired Productions[/url] Has [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/290100/Bulwark_Falconeer_Chronicles/]Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles[/url] in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Steam Next Fest.[/url]

This means you can get your hands on the Evolving Demo NOW!

Here is our good friend Tomas Sala, the games solo dev guiding you through the Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles Free Build Gameplay Reveal Trailer:
[previewyoutube=WzlDVcNaeS4;full][/previewyoutube]
Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles is a chilled base builder, players can explore an unforgiving environment, manage the flow of resources as you help to breathe life into the land and provide asylum to those lost. 
Meet and hire commanders and specialists that unlock new building options, units and stories. 

Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles requires a novel approach to building, something that isn’t about clicking over a screen but focusing on the world itself. In this sense, the game is one of experimental gameplay and controls, supported by a world and settlement that comes alive before your eyes.

notes.title: F*ck War - Raising funds for WarChild
notes.notes:
Ivar & The Horde released the anti-war song “Broken Walls”, dedicated to raising money for the children affected by the War In Ukraine. 

Leading on from the success of the Single, which amassed a total of 100,000 listeners, the brand-new “Broken Walls” Future Funk Squad Remix video is an opportunity for us to kickstart the [url=https://gofund.me/c48b9be4]GoFundMe[/url] campaign and to get us all to dig deep and contribute to the charity [url=https://www.warchild.org.uk/?gclid=CjwKCAjwl6OiBhA2EiwAuUwWZXrF6owrmiLCQaVdgy_ZhPYppr6rM3qVBUgtI53Qt4bU3BkMVMGZRhoCtKkQAvD_BwE]WarChild.[/url]

TURN THIS UP LOUD and watch the 'Future Funk Squad Remix' below:

[previewyoutube=I-QID5yUIfk;full]YOUTUBE LINK[/previewyoutube]

Released on [url=https://blackrazorrecords.com/]Black Razor Records.[/url] “Broken Walls” is the latest release from alternative rock/rap artists, [url=https://twitter.com/IvarandTheHorde]Ivar & The Horde [/url]([url=https://www.instagram.com/stubrootalmusic/]Stu Brootal[/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/kieronpepper/]Kieron Pepper[/url]), and draws inspiration from the war-themed arcade twin-stick shooter  ‘Tiny Troopers: Global Ops’ which launched on 9th March.

The game highlights a series of military megalomaniacs from around the world, and their greed-filled desire to cause conflict and chaos.

Every contribution on the [url=https://gofund.me/c48b9be4]GoFundM[/url]e will receive a download code for:

[url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/track/broken-walls]Ivar & The Horde - Broken Walls[/url]
[url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/track/broken-walls-future-funk-squad-remix]Ivar & The Horde - Broken Walls (Future Funk Squad Remix)[/url]

All proceeds from the song on Bandcamp and the GoFundMe will be donated to [url=https://www.warchild.org.uk/?gclid=CjwKCAjwl6OiBhA2EiwAuUwWZXrF6owrmiLCQaVdgy_ZhPYppr6rM3qVBUgtI53Qt4bU3BkMVMGZRhoCtKkQAvD_BwE]War Child.[/url]

Please give as much as you can, because 1 in every 6 children in the world are affected by armed conflict and we can make a difference. If you can't support financially. Please, share the message and get it seen by as many people as possible.

If you would like to know more about the charity. Visit them here: [url=https://www.warchild.org.uk/?gclid=CjwKCAjwl6OiBhA2EiwAuUwWZXrF6owrmiLCQaVdgy_ZhPYppr6rM3qVBUgtI53Qt4bU3BkMVMGZRhoCtKkQAvD_BwE]WarChild.[/url]

notes.title: Arcade Paradise EP Launches for Safe In Our World
notes.notes:
Every penny from your purchase goes straight to [url=https://safeinourworld.org/]Safe In Our World.[/url]💰

[url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/releases][h2]GO BUY IT NOW![/h2][/url]

The song is the lead track from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388870/Arcade_Paradise/]Arcade Paradise[/url]. A Game where the protagonist Ashley feels held back, suffocated, and mentally downtrodden. Arcade Paradise is a story that resonates closely with the message of [url=https://safeinourworld.org/]Safe In Our World[/url]. It is an inspirational message of what can be achieved, with help or just with the right motivation… how you CAN rise up against the machine, and how you CAN make your life great.

This is where you come in. We need YOU, the Wired Community to make some noise, Kick down the doors and scream that talking about Mental Health is GOOD!

How can YOU do this? There are lots of ways:

- Buy the single on [url=https://blackrazorrecords.bandcamp.com/releases ]Bandcamp[/url]. (Same price as a meal deal)
- Stream the song for the next week. Let's see if we can hit the charts. Bring on Top of the Pops.
- Share posts, blogs and playlists. The more we share. The more we can diminish the stigma around Mental Health
- Talk to someone and listen. a Simple "How's it going?" can make the world of difference.
- Make sure to tag us in every post, tweet and video. The more we share, the better.

Watch the Official Music Video below

[previewyoutube=GVfC5C5FopU;full][/previewyoutube]

All proceeds from sales of the Arcade Paradise EP from Bandcamp will be donated to the video games mental health charity Safe In Our World, but why did we choose them? Watch below to find out:

[previewyoutube=1eaAI3q1p3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

We have all the best streaming platforms below... Jump on and Stream away!

notes.title: Avicii Invector: Encore Edition Is Now Out On Meta Quest 2!
notes.notes:
Prepare to explore the rhythmic regions of unexplored space in a completely new way! AVICII Invector: Encore Edition is now available on Meta Quest 2!

Watch our brand new launch trailer showing the incredible journey taken by the game that Tim started, and how Quest 2 brings you AVICII's greatest hits in a new dimension!

[previewyoutube=wbUBOOvX1mo;full][/previewyoutube]


In loving memory of Swedish DJ Tim Bergling, most famously known by his professional name, AVICII, Hello There Games and Tim’s father, Klas Bergling, continue Tim’s vision of bringing new ways to experience his music, with AVICII Invector: Encore Edition.

Featuring 35 chart topping tracks such as Peace of Mind, Freak and S.O.S, AVICII Invector brings the futuristic rhythm action gameplay into a VR version for Meta Quest 2 which is available to purchase right now!

[h2]AVICII Invector: Encore Edition Features:[/h2]

⦁ 35 hit anthems from the phenomenal talent of late superstar AVICII.
⦁ SEVEN mesmerising worlds wrapped in a magnificent musical experience viewable in VR.
⦁ Turn up the volume and set yourself a challenge across FOUR complexity levels.
⦁ Lay down your high score and rise up the Global Leaderboards.
⦁ Explore a pure-hearted narrative journey set against the globally celebrated works of AVICII.

As with our releases on other platforms , all music royalties from each copy of the game sold will go to the Tim Bergling Foundation, which advocates for the recognition of suicide as a global health emergency and actively works to remove the stigma attached to suicide and mental health issues.

We'd like to take this moment to thank all of the AVICII fans for their support with Invector from the very beginning, it's a very personal project for us! And whilst we don't know where the journey for Invector ends, we're proud to have had you with us every step of the way!

You can find out more about the Tim Bergling Foundation by visiting: [url=https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/]https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/[/url]

And buy Avicii Invector On Meta Quest 2 by visiting: [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4048766301899067/]https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4048766301899067/[/url]

notes.title: Avicii | In Loving Memory
notes.notes:
Tim Bergling, known by his stage name AVICII, was a Superstar DJ whose tragic death deeply affected millions of people throughout the world. 

On the anniversary of Avicii's tragic passing, it is imperative that we continue to highlight the plight of those with lived experience of mental illness and suicide. On Tuesday 20th April, 2021, Wired Productions and developers Hello There Games will be donating 100% net receipts across all platforms to the Tim Bergling Foundation.

[previewyoutube=nGl-70pFF9w;full][/previewyoutube]

Its work includes supporting science-based organizations engaged in preventative actions against mental illness and suicide, particularly in young people.

Additionally - from the 20th of April until May the 4th, Avicii Invector will be available for 30% off on Nintendo Switch

We'll be having a special Live Stream tomorrow at 4.30pm BST on the Avicii Invector Steam page - join us, and let's be a little less lonely together.

About The Tim Bergling Foundation :

The Tim Bergling Foundation was created by Klas and Anki Bergling and their family after the death of their son Tim Bergling, also known as AVICII. Their mission is to advocate for the recognition of suicide as a global health emergency and promote removing the stigma attached to the discussion of mental health issues.

The Foundation supports science-based organizations engaged in preventative actions against mental illness and suicide, particularly in young people. As well as seeking to support aid work in areas where Tim also had passion such as climate change, global hunger and the preservation of wildlife and endangered species

You can check out their website here: [url=https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/]https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/[/url]

notes.title: Wired Direct - where was Avicii Invector?
notes.notes:
Good evening everyone!

First of all - thank you to ALL of the Avicii fans that turned out for the Direct today, we hope you enjoyed it just as much as we did!

However - checking the comments during the show and the Discord afterwards there was one prevailing question a lot of you had?
"Where was Invector? We were looking for Avicii news!"

So here's the deal (as we are super transparent and wouldn't want to say this and there not be anything)

There IS something coming for Invector, It's big, you're going to love it and you have every right to be excited! HECK we are so excited I can barely contain myself from telling you right now

However the things that needed to slide into place to announce it properly, just didn't quite make it in time.
We gave them every fighting chance to squeeze in at the end, even holding a space on the render specifically for them to be used if we could pull them up as late as this morning! But unfortunately the door closed on them and we couldn't quite get them into the Direct in time.

We don't like letting the community down, but we equally don't like 'half assing' something - throwing it out as an afterthought image or asset would not have been suitable, Invector deserves better, you all deserve better than that.

So, take this super apology - an acknowledgement that you may be disappointed, but a promise that in the next couple of months, we're going to make you smile harder than you ever could have thought.

Hearts on our sleeve <3

notes.title: An Update reference our Avicii Switch Lite Charity Raffle
notes.notes:
Hey there folks - hope your Friday is treating you all with kindness!

Just wanted to give everyone a quick update reference the charity Ebay auction for the 5th Avicii Switch Lite.

If you bought a raffle ticket (thank you!!) you will have received an email from ebay this morning stating the auction had been removed.

Long story short - our auction was suspended:

Despite working directly with eBay, a separate team, unaware, ended the auction. They have apologised but it is irreversible.

Safe In Our World is going to refund ALL donations. As a small charity with no grants, it is a bit of a pain, but the right thing to do.

In the meantime please sit tight and await your refund - and we are currently setting up a new home to hold the auction.

We will share more soon - thank you for your patience! 💕

notes.title: Raise money for Charity with our Custom Switch Lite! ◢◤
notes.notes:
Yesterday we released Avicii Invector Encore Edition to the world, bringing 10 new songs to Steam - and the game to Nintendo Switch for the first time.

As part of the celebrations, we created 5 custom White Nintendo Switches. Four were released via competitions in the build-up to the games' release.

But for the last we are doing something a little bit special...

We've placed the final switch on Ebay as a raffle auction - Raffle entries are available to purchase for just £5, with every single penny raised being donated to Safe In Our World, the video games mental health charity. The winner will receive a custom Nintendo Switch console and copy of AVICII Invector: Encore Edition.

Given the nature of Avicii's legacy which has included discussion mental health and awareness of it as a global issue - it felt only fair to honour that part of Avicii's story, and use the power of the Avicii fanbase and gamers worldwide to help support a charity which combines all of those elements in a powerful way.

notes.title: AVICII Invector is out now!
notes.notes:
Yesterday was a special moment for us all, and also an emotional one. The world was frozen for many the day we heard that Tim had passed away - this wonderful man had spent hours with the team, laughing, winning, losing and being a bright presence... then he was gone.

Earlier this year Oskar and his team heard that Tim's father, Klas Bergling was setting up the Tim Bergling Foundation, and the team knew they wanted to get involved. With his father's blessing, development started again to finish what Tim had started. It was decided to head back into the mix, overhaul the visuals and mechanics as well as add a new world to the game which would be in memory of Tim, and include several tracks into the game from his posthumous album “Tim.”

If you haven't already visited [url=http://timberglingfoundation.org/] The Tim Bergling Foundation [/url], please do check them out. <3 

Over the next week you can gain 10% savings. All music royalites are being donated to the Tim Bergling Founation, in addition to a donated on every unit sold to [url=http://safeinourworld.org/] Safe In Our world [/url], the video games mental health charity.

Thank you for your support

notes.title: Watch the Avicii Tribute Concert Now
notes.notes:
As we prepare for the launch of AVICII Invector, we were very honoured to be guests at last nights AVICII Tribute Concert in Stockholm, Sweden.

AVICII Invector has been an emotional ride, from working with Tim in the early days of development, to deciding to continue the project and the help and support of his father, Klas Bergling, and the new Tim Bergling foundation.

Last night was pure emotion, we sang, danced and much more importantly, we remembered our friend. We wish he could see the outpouring of love, how much he meant to everyone.

You can watch the event below. Know that all music royalties will be given to the Tim Bergling Foundation and we're also making a donation to the new video games mental health charity, Safe In Our World. If you ever feel alone, feel like you don't have anywhere to turn to, please reach out for help, start the conversation. You can learn more  or find local contact information for support by visiting www.safeinourworld.org

[previewyoutube=h2Tzd7MiOj8;full][/previewyoutube]
Avicii Tribute Concert (starts at 02:58:36) celebrates the life and music of Tim Bergling - AVICII - live at Friends Arena in Stockholm, Sweden together with 58,000 fans from all over the world.
